name: PUToggle
description: Binary on/off control rendered as a pill-shaped track with a sliding circular thumb. Used for settings rows and preference switches. No toggle/switch exists on any PurpleUI platform today - this spec defines the contract ahead of implementation.
notes: Spec only - no PurpleUI toggle/switch implementation exists yet on any platform. Contract for a follow-up build (kept as prose here alongside the machine-readable `implementation` status above for human readability). docPage is null for the same reason - there is no src/app/(docs)/inputs/toggle page on disk; "/inputs/toggle" was a dead link left in the original spec before normalization.

anatomy.track: Pill shape (radius.full). Background cross-fades between the off colour and colors.brand as the on state changes.
anatomy.thumb: Circular, centred vertically in the track with equal inset on all sides. Slides from the left edge (off) to the right edge (on).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the toggle is tapped

props.name: dark
props.description: Dark surface variant - lightens the off-state track so it reads on navy backgrounds

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction and dims the control to 40% opacity

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible aria-label (web) or accessibilityLabel (native) - required whenever no visible text label sits beside the toggle

disabled.notes: applies on top of whichever on/off + variant colours are resolved above

tokens.animation: thumb slides left/right on a spring transition; track background colour cross-fades

accessibility.notes: expose aria-checked (web) / accessibilityValue (native) reflecting the on/off state; disabled toggles must still announce label and state, just not accept input
